objective: Open the interpreter, evaluate arithmetic, print a message, and leave interactive mode.
review_note: Actual terminal instructions and TRY_THIS reviewed; Spanish companion is an alternate-language representation. TRY_THIS uses an undefined your_age name, so define it before evaluating that optional expression.

objective: Print text, numbers, expressions, and a short story with correctly paired quotes.
review_note: The runnable example is teaching material; assigned work is changing messages and writing the TRY_THIS story.

objective: Create and run a script, explain top-to-bottom execution, and use comments to disable and restore a line.
review_note: Actual code and all three TRY_THIS steps reviewed.

objective: Store and update personal facts, calculate with variables, and swap values using a temporary variable.
review_note: The temporary-variable swap is a prerequisite-friendly introduction; the later no-temporary-variable challenge remains distinct practice.

objective: Compare integer and floating-point arithmetic, calculate time and prices, and inspect a division-by-zero error.
review_note: Source's // explanation says it drops the decimal part; this is inaccurate for negative operands. Flag floor-division caveat and teach actual floor semantics in the earlier numbers lesson.

objective: Combine and format text, inspect string methods, fix nested quotes, and repeat strings.
review_note: The split example briefly produces a list but does not yet require list manipulation; formal list work follows.

objective: Read names and numeric input, build a tip calculator, and observe failed string-to-number conversion.
review_note: Invalid numeric input is intentionally demonstrated rather than handled; exception-handling assignments come later.

objective: Predict branches and build age and number-guess checks with compound conditions.
review_note: The fixed password example is a condition demonstration, not a secure authentication design.

objective: Create, index, change, and aggregate lists; investigate an out-of-range access.
review_note: Full code and TRY_THIS inspected; no iteration required for the assigned list edits.

objective: Iterate over lists and ranges, accumulate scores, and print multiplication and countdown sequences.
review_note: All examples and three variations reviewed; count-down range uses a negative step.

objective: Repeat until a condition changes, validate repeated guesses, and stop a deliberate infinite loop.
review_note: The deliberate infinite loop must be run interactively and stopped with Ctrl+C, not in unattended test execution.

objective: Store labeled records, count words, iterate over key-value pairs, and compare missing-key access with get().
review_note: Dictionary iteration introduces simple two-name unpacking; deeper unpacking practice is later.

objective: Define reusable functions with parameters, return values, and defaults; implement conversion, average, and parity helpers.
review_note: The source includes supplied examples; TRY_THIS contains the original independent function work.

objective: Read a supplied text dataset, parse rows, count lines, and identify the highest-scoring student.
review_note: Source uses unclosed open() calls, although its comment supplies a safer with-open form. Note resource-management limitation; verify data/sample.txt before final inclusion.

objective: Extend the student grade reporter with new records, filtering, alternate data, and optional report-file output.
concepts: functions;lists of dictionaries;file parsing;format specifications;generator expressions
review_note: Full implementation and four TRY_THIS variations reviewed. Baseline contains generator expressions and depends on the previous exercise's sample file; schedule after those skills, not solely by the beginner folder label.

objective: Implement named constants and cooking-time functions with parameters, return values, and docstrings.
review_note: Full instructions, introduction, starter contract and executable test cases reviewed. Starter intentionally omits a parameter and other functions; this is learner work, not a defect. Tests explicitly check docstrings.

objective: Express four arcade-game outcomes as reusable Boolean functions.
review_note: Instructions and all supplied Boolean cases reviewed. Keeps useful truth-table practice distinct from condition-branch exercises.

objective: Not assigned: deprecated power-billing exercise has contradictory API names and a dimensionally invalid energy conversion.
review_note: Instructions demand get_kW_value/get_kWh_value, while starter and tests demand get_kW_amount/get_kwh_amount. Watts divided by 1000 then 3600 is not an energy calculation without duration. Reference tests pass their own legacy contract but do not resolve these instruction defects; Currency Exchange is the stronger arithmetic assignment.

objective: Calculate currency conversion, whole-bill counts, remainders, and fee-adjusted exchange value.
review_note: Actual six-function requirements and all supplied numeric test cases reviewed. Follow primary instructions and tests; a floating-denomination docstring example is outside the stated integer-denomination contract. This is arithmetic practice, not financial advice or production currency handling.

objective: Classify simulated reactor conditions using compound comparisons, efficiency bands, and threshold intervals.
review_note: Read complete instructions and test data around criticality and efficiency boundaries. Retain as progressive branching practice; check 90% and 110% boundaries against the written inclusive specification.

objective: Implement card values, ties, ace choices, and hand decisions from a six-part rule specification.
review_note: Full instructions and every supplied hand case reviewed. Extra tuple prerequisite added despite track metadata omitting it; equal-valued cards must return the original card pair.

objective: Clean an essay's titles, sentence endings, surrounding whitespace, and word choices.
review_note: Full four-part brief, starter contract and tests reviewed, including absent replacement words and one-sided whitespace.

objective: Transform vocabulary using prefixes, joined word groups, suffix spelling rules, and indexed sentence words.
review_note: Read full brief, introduction and test cases. Unlike its minimal track prerequisites, this task requires list indexing and splitting; schedule after basic lists. Preserve its string-method approach rather than requiring loops.

objective: Render an event handbill with exact-width borders, formatted dates, Unicode icons, and missing optional data.
review_note: WIP source mixes obsolete class/method examples with module-function starter/tests. Preserve only as an explicitly annotated optional challenge using the actual four-function test contract; missing dates and missing icons are covered. Confirm reference-test result before final disposition.

objective: Track and combine card rounds, compare positional averages, and update the final card under a game rule.
review_note: Complete instructions, stubs and test data reviewed. The stated median means the positional middle element of an odd-length hand; do not add a sorting requirement that the source does not ask for.

objective: Manage express and normal queues while distinguishing in-place changes from sorted copies.
review_note: Complete instructions and tests reviewed. One queue-identity test incorrectly compares the built-in type object with 0/1 and never executes its assertions; record this coverage defect. Preserve the assignment's in-place requirement from its written brief.

objective: Round scores, filter failing and high-scoring students, construct grade intervals, and rank or locate students.
review_note: All six requirements and actual cases reviewed, including round(0.5), round(1.5), empty inputs, non-divisible grade ranges, and first-match behavior.

objective: Normalize coordinate representations, match and combine treasure records, and produce a cleaned multiline report.
review_note: Full five-part brief and all supplied tuple/report test data reviewed. Formatting and the final newline are part of the tested contract.

objective: Create, increment, decrement, remove, and list stock entries without letting counts become negative.
review_note: Full instructions and tests reviewed, including absent decrement targets and absent removals. The example's item order is not an explicit rule and supplied tests do not distinguish sorted from insertion order; do not invent an ordering requirement.

objective: Build cart and recipe operations, preserve requested dictionary ordering, and reconcile fulfillment against stock.
review_note: Full six-part brief and test bodies reviewed. Tests import separate dict_methods_test_data.py, which requires resource-level review. Distinguish notes initialized at one per distinct item from add-item frequency increments.

objective: Repair train lists and routing dictionaries using argument packing, iterable unpacking, and matrix transposition.
review_note: Full five-part brief, incomplete starter signatures and all supplied cases reviewed. Changing signatures to accept arbitrary positional/keyword arguments is intentional learner work; do not assign this solely after basic dictionaries.

objective: Deduplicate and classify ingredients, combine shopping needs, and separate restricted or singleton items using sets.
review_note: All seven instructions, starter contracts and test logic reviewed. Supplied category and test datasets remain support files. Source docstring loosely describes category intersections; use the brief's provided repeated-ingredient set, not an intersection-of-all-dishes interpretation.

objective: Model independent alien state, shared creation counts, methods, and a factory for collections of aliens.
review_note: Complete seven-part brief and all executable cases reviewed. A no-op collision_detection is explicitly required, so its pass/None behavior is intentional scaffolding, not an incomplete task.

objective: Yield seat identifiers and fixed-width ticket codes lazily, skip row 13, and map passengers to seats.
review_note: Full instructions and every test reviewed, including inspect.isgenerator and row-13 skipping. Generators are a required contract; eagerly returning a list is not equivalent.

objective: Parse log severities into enums, produce numeric short forms, expose an alias, and enumerate canonical members.
review_note: WIP API mismatch: instructions use title-case enum names, while tests require uppercase members and import LogLevelInt, absent from the starter. Preserve as an annotated optional challenge only, with the existing test/reference identifiers made explicit; do not silently pretend the instructions are complete.

objective: Not assigned: reservation expectations contradict the task's stated guest order and completeness.
review_note: Full six-part instructions and test bodies reviewed. arrange_reservations must seat Walter first under the prose, but test_arrange_reservations_1 expects Walter omitted and Frank first. Tests also call an undocumented no-argument form. Reference passes its tests, but that cannot reconcile the contradictory contract; quarantine pending source repair.

objective: Implement a zero-argument function that returns the exact greeting and passes its test.
review_note: Actual test distinguishes return from print. Preserve as a return-contract exercise, distinct from the earlier print-based Hello World.

objective: Determine Gregorian leap years with divisibility and century exceptions.
review_note: Read introduction's complete 4/100/400 rule and all century-boundary tests; the one-line instructions alone omit the essential rule.

objective: Classify valid triangle side lists as equilateral, isosceles, or scalene.
review_note: Full instructions and tests reviewed. Equilateral counts as isosceles; degenerate equality cases are explicitly untested and optional, so do not impose an unsupported strict choice.

objective: Calculate chessboard doubling totals and reject invalid square numbers with the required exception message.
review_note: Read instructions, introduction, append and every test. Source metadata omits the exception prerequisite; move after raising exceptions rather than basic arithmetic alone.

objective: Recognize numbers equal to the sum of their digits raised to the digit count.
review_note: All numeric cases read, including zero and seven-digit examples. Requires iteration or equivalent digit processing despite minimal upstream prerequisites.

objective: Count iterative Collatz transitions and raise the specified ValueError for nonpositive inputs.
review_note: Full introduction explains the transitions; append adds required error message absent from the short primary statement. All cases reviewed, including one and a million.

objective: Apply ordered response rules to questions, shouting, silence, and ordinary statements.
review_note: All whitespace, punctuation, numeric-only and combined shouting-question tests reviewed. Keep after string methods, which its track prerequisite list omits.

objective: Compose ordered sound fragments for factors of 3, 5, and 7, falling back to numeric text.
review_note: Read primary, introduction, Python-specific append and tests. Distinct useful follow-up to FizzBuzz because simultaneous factors concatenate multiple fragments.

objective: Score Cartesian landing points against concentric circle boundaries.
review_note: Full brief and all edge/axis/diagonal cases reviewed. Points exactly on each circle count inside that circle.

objective: Classify positive integers by the sum of their proper divisors and reject invalid input.
review_note: Read complete spec, exception append, and all tests. Tests include values above 33 million, so place after factorization and cost reasoning despite upstream difficulty 1.

objective: Return reversed text while preserving punctuation, empty input, and Unicode code points.
review_note: Full brief and tests reviewed, including wide CJK characters. Stronger main-path reference for the overlapping learn.python reverse-string challenge, which can remain optional practice.

objective: Check case-insensitively whether text contains every English alphabet letter.
review_note: Full instruction/context and all cases reviewed. Numbers cannot substitute for missing letters, and 26 distinct mixed-case characters need not cover the alphabet.

objective: Detect repeated letters while ignoring case, spaces, and repeated hyphens.
review_note: Read all supplied mixed-case, empty, spaced and repeated-hyphen tests. Distinct from pangram: it checks uniqueness rather than alphabet coverage.

objective: Validate ISBN-10 length, characters, check-digit position, and weighted checksum with or without hyphens.
review_note: Complete specification and every invalid-input test reviewed. Only the final check position may contain X; invalid letters cannot be silently discarded to make a valid length.

objective: Rotate alphabetic characters by a key while retaining case, punctuation, spaces and digits.
review_note: Read full brief, stub and all tests, including wraparound and unchanged nonletters. Historical cipher exercise, not a modern encryption implementation.

objective: Map a DNA sequence to its specified RNA complements, including empty input.
review_note: Read brief, introduction and every test. Complements are G:C, C:G, T:A and A:U. No unrequested invalid-input behavior added.

objective: Look up the numeric code for a resistor band and return the ordered color list.
review_note: Read complete task and tests. Foundation of the progressively harder four-exercise resistor sequence, not redundant with multi-band variants.

objective: Decode the first two color bands as a decimal number and ignore any extra bands.
review_note: All cases reviewed, including leading black yielding a single digit and ignoring a third color.

objective: Decode a third multiplier band and format a resistance label using metric units.
review_note: Full brief and tests read. Tests require megaohms and gigaohms as well as the briefly introduced kiloohms; extra colors are ignored.

objective: Decode one-, four- and five-band resistors with tolerance percentages and decimal metric labels.
review_note: Full instructions, introduction and tests reviewed. Single black band has no tolerance label; five-band examples require fractional metric labels such as 2.54 megaohms.

objective: Decode five binary-string positions into ordered actions and optionally reverse the action list.
review_note: Append overrides generic number-input prose: Python API takes a binary string. All tests reviewed, including zero and reversing an empty action list. Bitwise arithmetic is not required.

objective: Find case-insensitive anagrams while excluding the same word and preserving candidate spelling.
review_note: Full specification and tests reviewed. Contrary to brief's ASCII-only claim, supplied tests require Greek letters too. Set equality alone fails repeated-letter counts; checksum equality also fails.

objective: Generate an inclusive range of cumulative nursery-rhyme verses from reusable phrases.
review_note: Read all verses and exact single/multiple/full-rhyme expectations. Returns a list of single-line verses, not the display-form multiline text. Recursive implementation is optional, not a prerequisite.

objective: Find the original index of an item in a sorted list by repeatedly halving the search interval.
review_note: Full brief, append and tests reviewed. Missing values, including empty input and crossed bounds, require ValueError with exact message value not in array. Unlike metadata, exceptions must come first.

objective: Count differing positions in equal-length DNA sequences and reject mismatched lengths.
review_note: All instructions and test bodies read, including either strand empty. Exact error message is Strands must be of equal length. Generator expressions are an optional refinement rather than a requirement.

objective: Flatten arbitrarily nested lists while preserving integers, including zero, and omitting None.
review_note: Full brief and tests reviewed. Five- and six-level nesting prevent a single-level flatten. Truthiness filtering would incorrectly discard zero. Explicit-stack traversal is a valid alternative after stacks.

objective: Format a customer greeting with the correct ordinal suffix, including the 11, 12 and 13 exceptions.
review_note: Full brief, introduction and tests read. Tests span one to three digits; checking only the last digit fails 112. Source metadata omits conditionals and arithmetic requirements.

objective: Compute square of a sum, sum of squares and their difference for the first N natural numbers.
review_note: Complete brief, stubs and nine tests reviewed. Closed-form optimization can follow complexity lessons; source explicitly permits researching efficient formulas but does not require deriving them first.

objective: Implement append, one-level concatenation, filter, length, map, directional folds and reversal without existing equivalents.
review_note: All eight contracts and test bodies reviewed. concat removes one nesting level only, unlike Flatten Array. Direction-dependent division and string fold tests establish argument order; metadata understates callable prerequisites.

objective: Transform score-to-letter-group data into a lowercase-letter-to-score mapping.
review_note: Read complete instructions, introduction and all four fixtures. This is an in-memory transformation exercise, not a database or external ETL project.

objective: Implement a SpaceAge class with planet-specific methods converting seconds to rounded orbital years.
review_note: Read all docs and tests. Python append requires a class and eight on_planet methods despite registry omitting classes. Uses exercise-defined Earth-year seconds, not a calendar-age calculator.

objective: Sum unique multiples of supplied factors strictly below a limit, including zero and empty-factor cases.
review_note: All docs and cases reviewed. Append claims sorted factors but test passes [3,0], so do not rely on sorted order. Zero must not trigger division-by-zero or zero-step range.

objective: Return a datetime exactly one billion seconds after a supplied moment.
review_note: Full brief, append, introduction and five tests read. Accepts and returns datetime, including exact day rollover; does not require authoring a class despite registry prerequisite.

objective: Return a personalized sentence with a default name when called without an argument.
review_note: Brief, introduction, stub and three tests read. Learner must change the stub signature to permit no argument. Sets are not required, despite track prerequisite metadata.

objective: Compute the integer square root of a positive perfect square without library root functions or exponentiation shortcuts.
review_note: Full docs and six tests reviewed. Perfect-square positive inputs only; no invented nonsquare/negative handling. Keep source's no-built-in constraint. Narrative claim that library math necessarily uses more power is unsupported, not a lesson objective.

objective: Translate words and phrases with ordered vowel, consonant-cluster, qu, xr, yt and y rules.
review_note: Read all four rules and all cases. Requires strings and iteration beyond registry's conditionals-only prerequisites. Initial y is consonant; y after a consonant cluster is vowel-like.

objective: Verify that three kinds of brackets are matched and correctly nested while ignoring other text.
review_note: Complete brief and tests read, including crossing pairs, unexpected early closers, unfinished openers, math and LaTeX. Counting each bracket kind alone is insufficient.

objective: Classify equality and contiguous containment of two lists using four distinct exported constants.
review_note: Full brief, stub docstring and every test reviewed. Containment is contiguous, not subset membership. Tests include million-element input, overlapping false starts and values that must not be confused through string conversion.

objective: Encode and decode reversed-alphabet substitution with lowercase normalization, retained digits and five-character groups.
review_note: Full instructions and all encode/decode tests read. Punctuation removed, numbers retained, decode ignores arbitrary spacing and does not restore original word boundaries. Adds grouping and normalization beyond Rotational Cipher.

objective: Return a square, horizontally and vertically symmetric letter diamond with exact padding.
review_note: Full requirements and all expected rows reviewed, including Z. API returns list of rows rather than printing; trailing spaces are significant and must not be stripped.

objective: Count set bits in a nonnegative integer without using built-in bit counting.
review_note: Full instructions, introduction and all tests read. Includes zero and 2,000,000,000; bit_count is explicitly forbidden, unlike a mere shortcut preference.

objective: Translate three-character RNA codons to amino-acid names and stop at the first stop codon.
review_note: Full codon table, rules and every test read. Process nonoverlapping triples; do not resume after a stop codon or emit STOP in result. Invalid/incomplete-codon behavior is unspecified and not invented.

objective: Return repeated prime factors in ascending order while reducing the remaining quotient.
review_note: Full brief and all tests read, including 93,819,012,551. One returns empty list. Large-prime case motivates square-root stopping rather than scanning every integer up to original input.

objective: Express integers up to 999,999,999,999 in English words with correct scale groups and hyphens.
review_note: Complete instructions, append and all expected text reviewed. No and between hundreds and tens. Exact out-of-range error required for negative or trillion input. Helper decomposition can be iterative or recursive.

objective: Build an uppercase acronym while treating hyphens as word separators and removing other punctuation.
review_note: Full brief and all cases read. Apostrophes and underscores must not create extra initials. Regular expressions are an optional technique despite practice metadata, not a required prerequisite.

objective: Return every fixed-length contiguous digit substring in input order with explicit invalid-length errors.
review_note: Full brief, append, starter and tests reviewed. Preserve leading zeros and repeated windows. Empty source, zero length, negative length and excessive length have different required error messages; append's slice() name is a typo, API is slices().

objective: Compress consecutive character runs and decode multi-digit run counts while retaining case and whitespace.
review_note: Full brief and all tests read. Single runs omit the count, spaces are data, and unencoded inputs contain no digits. Regex is optional. Round-trip property supplies stronger verification than individual examples alone.

objective: Generate primes to find a one-based nth prime and reject indexes below one.
review_note: Read complete instructions, append and tests. Includes 10,001st prime, so inefficient naive full-divisor search should follow optimization instruction. Generators are an optional implementation, not forced by tests. No standard-library prime shortcut.

objective: Assemble an inclusive range of cumulative song verses from ordinal names and gifts.
review_note: Full song, append and all test logic read. Overlaps House but adds day ordinals, commas and the special and before the first gift; retain as optional reinforcement. Tuple storage is optional.

objective: Convert positive integers through 3,999 to canonical Roman numerals using subtractive pairs.
review_note: Read full brief, essential introduction and every test. Six subtractive pairs must be handled before smaller denominations. No zero/negative conversion invented because task scope excludes them.

objective: Count normalized words and numbers while distinguishing contraction apostrophes from surrounding quotes.
review_note: Full specification and tests reviewed. Underscores separate words, interior apostrophes remain, doubled surrounding quotes are discarded. Stronger main-path word-count than plain split-based beginner variants; retain those as preparatory practice.

objective: Sum case-insensitive letter scores from a supplied point table.
review_note: Complete brief, table, introduction and tests read. Empty word returns zero; entire alphabet checks all mapping entries. Regex is unnecessary. Reuses ETL's mapping idea with a new aggregation objective.

objective: Generate adjacent consequence lines from variadic items and qualify only the final line.
review_note: Read primary, Python append and every test. Stub signature intentionally incomplete. Calls use *input_data and qualifier keyword; zero items returns empty list, no hardcoded final nail.

objective: Implement repeatable Luhn validation through an instance method with strict input filtering and right-based parity.
review_note: Full brief, introduction, starter and tests reviewed. Only spaces are removed, other nondigits invalidate; require at least two digits after removal. Repeated valid() calls must not corrupt stored state. Checksum validity is not identity or account verification.

objective: Generate six persistent ability scores from four dice each, discarding the lowest, and compute constitution-based hitpoints.
review_note: All docs and tests reviewed. Negative modifiers require floor rounding, not truncation. Tests only check ranges and persistence, not distribution or actual four-dice procedure; passing constant scores is insufficient to meet the brief.

objective: Give each robot a stable random name and reset it without colliding with existing names.
review_note: Full specification and tests read. Reseeding before reset must not recreate the old name. Supplied tests sample only two robots and do not exhaust collision space; implement uniqueness required by prose rather than relying on lucky samples.

objective: Normalize valid NANP phone strings and expose cleaned number, area code and formatted output with precise validation errors.
review_note: Read full brief, error append and every test. Formatting punctuation is allowed but substituted punctuation/letters are rejected. Tests add area_code and pretty() contracts absent stub; input is a string, preserving leading digits during validation.

objective: Validate queen coordinates and determine attacks through equal row, column or diagonal displacement.
review_note: Complete docs and tests read. Board is zero-indexed: negative wording not positive does not exclude zero. Coincident queen positions must raise the exact specified ValueError rather than report an attack.

objective: Transpose ragged multiline text while preserving original spaces and adding only necessary interior padding.
review_note: All brief and exact tests read. Do not indiscriminately rstrip output because original trailing spaces are meaningful. Plain zip would truncate longer rows. Unpacking is optional implementation knowledge.

objective: Score five unordered dice under twelve categories with distinct exported category constants.
review_note: Read entire scoring table, starter and tests. Full house excludes five-of-kind; four-of-kind permits five but scores only four dice. Enum implementation optional; classes are not required by actual API.

objective: Compute one synchronous generation of a finite binary cell grid from eight-neighbor rules.
review_note: Full docs, starter and tests reviewed. Edge behavior is finite rather than wrapping. All cells must use old-generation neighbors, so sequential in-place mutation would be wrong. Empty matrix supported; not an interactive game project.

objective: Classify reachable tic-tac-toe boards as ongoing, draw or win and reject wrong turns or play after a win.
review_note: Full docs and every test read. X starts; simultaneous wins or winner/count inconsistency are invalid. Multiple winning lines by the same final X move can be valid. Exact three specified error messages required.

objective: Find every row-maximum and column-minimum intersection and reject ragged matrices.
review_note: Read all docs and tests. Equality ties count despite narrative taller/shorter wording. Return one-based row/column dictionaries; output order immaterial. Empty matrix valid, irregular shape raises exact irregular matrix message.

objective: Decode fixed-size pipe-and-underscore digit cells, preserving unknown cells as question marks and separating rows with commas.
review_note: Full instructions, append, introduction and all tests read. API receives list of lines rather than string implied by append. Cells are 3 columns by 4 lines; invalid dimensions raise distinct messages, unreadable valid-size cells do not raise.

objective: Track robot coordinates and orientation through left, right and advance commands on an infinite grid.
review_note: Full brief, starter and every movement test read. North and east increase y and x. Expose coordinates tuple and direction; decorators and customized descriptors are optional rather than requirements implied by metadata.

objective: Maintain a deduplicated school roster, sorted by grade then name, and record success for each attempted addition.
review_note: Complete brief, Python append, stub and every test reviewed. Name uniqueness is school-wide, not only per grade. added() returns chronological booleans rather than just the last result. Nonexistent grades return empty lists.

objective: Implement the Sieve of Eratosthenes by marking multiples to return primes through an inclusive limit.
review_note: Full brief, worked procedure, introduction, stub and all expected primes reviewed. Algorithm is required even though source explicitly acknowledges tests only validate outputs. Differs from nth-prime generation through a fixed inclusive upper bound.

objective: Find all increasing integer Pythagorean triples with a specified sum.
review_note: Full docs and tests read, including sum 30,000. Python append explicitly requires list of lists, not sets despite registry set practice label. Triplet order ascending; enclosing result order arbitrary. Place after search-space optimization.

objective: Implement a fixed-capacity FIFO buffer with read, write, overwrite and clear operations and custom full/empty errors.
review_note: Full operation narrative, exception append, starter and all tests read. overwrite appends when capacity available and discards oldest only when full. Error subclasses must preserve exception.args exact messages, not only a message attribute.

objective: Parse whitespace-separated numeric rows into a Matrix class and retrieve one-based rows and columns.
review_note: Full docs, starter and all eight tests reviewed. Rectangular matrices and multi-digit numbers required. NumPy explicitly unsupported. Simpler than Transpose's ragged-space contract, so place before it despite source order.

objective: Expose original scores, latest score, personal best and descending top three without mutating score order.
review_note: Full primary, append and every test read. Ties retained, fewer than three valid, original order preserved after best/top methods. Significantly easier than other registry difficulty-3 units; place in introductory class practice.

objective: Assign two cups per diagram row to alphabetically sorted children and decode each child's four plants.
review_note: Read full docs, starter and all tests. Caller may override roster in any order; default twelve-name roster must work without students argument despite incomplete stub signature. Return plant names in diagram row order.

objective: Generate decreasing bottle-song verses with number words, singular/plural agreement and blank separators.
review_note: Read complete lyrics, stub and all tests. API takes start and count rather than ending verse. Last verse uses no bottles. Optional reinforcement of data-driven song generation, distinct grammar/countdown boundary behavior from House and Twelve Days.

objective: Decode eight low-order flag bits through an allergy-query method and list property while ignoring higher bits.
review_note: Full specification, starter and all tests read. lst is a property rather than method. Unknown higher score bits ignored. These are fictional exercise scores, not a model of real allergy testing; frame as bitmask practice.

objective: Implement keyed cyclic letter shifts, reversible decoding and a randomly generated default key of at least 100 lowercase letters.
review_note: All docs and tests read. Default key minimum length is required by prose but not tested. Append distinguishes random from secrets; historical Vigenere remains insecure regardless of key-generation module. Keep security explanation scoped to original learning material.

objective: Rank five-card poker hands and return every tied strongest hand using category and kicker comparisons.
review_note: Full terse brief and all executable cases read. Brief delegates rules to external Wikipedia; local tests enumerate category hierarchy, multiple-deck ties, kickers and ace-low straights. No external rule page reviewed yet; flag rule-reference dependency. Classes optional.

objective: Parse arithmetic word questions with negative integers and evaluate strictly left to right, rejecting invalid grammar or unknown operations.
review_note: All five instruction iterations, append and every test read. Distinguishes syntax error from unknown operation. Source bare-except example is overly broad; teach narrow exception handling from earlier lessons. Evaluation is custom left-to-right, not normal Python precedence.

objective: Normalize text and encode it by square-near rectangle columns with exact trailing-space padding.
review_note: Full algorithm, worked grid and all tests read. Retain digits, remove punctuation, empty-normalized input returns empty. Output grouping includes significant trailing spaces. Comprehensions optional, not mandatory prerequisite.

objective: Model a normalized date-free clock with equality, repr, zero-padded string display and minute addition/subtraction.
review_note: Full primary, extensive Python append, starter and all tests read. Negative and multi-day overflow normalize modulo a day. repr must recreate Clock(hour, minute); __str__ displays HH:MM. Addition/subtraction operate on minute counts.

objective: Count every complete axis-aligned rectangle in a rectangular ASCII diagram, including shared edges and minimal cells.
review_note: Full brief, diagram breakdown and all tests reviewed. Four plus corners and continuous valid sides required; 1x1 character-corner rectangles count. Classes not required despite metadata. Rectangular input guaranteed.

objective: Build an iterable singly linked LIFO list with nodes, push/pop, head, length and reversal.
review_note: Full instructions, Python append, introduction, starter and every test read. Constructor pushes each incoming value so head is last input. Iteration follows head-to-tail. Empty head/pop exact custom error; backing with a plain list would violate required linked structure.

objective: Refactor the supplied nested-scan tree builder into clear efficient construction while validating record and parent IDs.
review_note: Full source implementation, brief, append and tests read. This working baseline is explicitly the assignment to refactor, not a reference solution to exclude. Existing vague errors must change to three tested messages. Empty input returns None; children sorted by ID.

objective: Detect Hex-board winners by traversing same-player six-neighbor paths between that player's assigned opposite edges.
review_note: Full rules and every test read, including dead-end forks, rectangular boards and spiral paths. X connects left/right, O top/bottom. Mismatched counts allowed; unlike Tic-Tac-Toe, do not impose turn-count validation. Return empty string if no winner.

objective: Convert digit lists between arbitrary integer bases, normalizing zeros and rejecting invalid bases or digits.
review_note: All instructions, append, introduction and tests read. Empty list represents zero, output zero is [0], leading zeros removed. Tests establish input-base error priority when both bases invalid. Conversion must be implemented rather than delegated.

objective: Translate delivery shorthand into ISO datetime strings using time cutoffs, weekdays, month starts and quarter ends.
review_note: Read every rule table, introduction and test. Python datetime task, unrelated to Swift language. In-month month target means next year, while in-quarter quarter target means this year. Weekend EOW input unspecified; no invented behavior. NOW may cross date boundaries.

objective: Fill a square nested list clockwise from one, shrinking the active bounds toward the center.
review_note: Full docs and every expected matrix read. Zero size returns empty list; odd and even sizes tested. No class or dictionary required despite registry metadata. Ensure rows are independent objects rather than aliased repeated references.

objective: Encode unsigned 32-bit integers as seven-bit chunks with continuation flags and decode multiple values from a byte stream.
review_note: Complete docs, lookup examples and every test read. Maximum 32-bit value occupies five bytes. Incomplete trailing continuation, even zero-valued payload, must raise incomplete sequence. Lists contain integer byte values, not textual binary strings.

objective: Find a minimum-cardinality coin combination for an exact target, including denominations where greedy selection fails.
review_note: Full docs and every test read. [1,10,11] target20 must use [10,10]; greedy fails. Zero returns empty list, negative target has separate error, impossible sums use specified error. Expected result lists are ascending; returning only a coin count is insufficient.

objective: List sorted combinations of distinct digits 1 through 9 with a fixed size and sum, excluding constrained digits.
review_note: Full task, examples, diagram alt descriptions, stub and all tests read. Not a full Sudoku solver. Distinct digits and exclusions matter; output sorted inside each combination and lexicographically across combinations. itertools.combinations is optional after module instruction.

objective: Annotate empty grid cells with eight-neighbor flower counts while preserving flowers and zero-neighbor blanks.
review_note: All docs and tests reviewed. Empty and zero-width boards valid; ragged widths or characters other than space and star raise exact board-invalid error. Append names board() incorrectly; actual API annotate(). Related to Game of Life but static annotation plus validation.

objective: Encode and reconstruct text using a zigzag rail traversal and rail-by-rail reading.
review_note: Full algorithm and all encoding/decoding tests read. Different rail counts and incomplete last zigzag tested. Narrative strips spaces before example; local test inputs already contain no spaces, so do not invent a general punctuation-normalization requirement.

objective: Find smallest and largest palindromic products in an inclusive factor range and return every matching factor pair.
review_note: Full docs, stub and tests reviewed, including four-digit factors. No result returns (None,[]); inverted bounds raise min must be <= max. Append demands min_factor default0 absent stub and tests; learner should supply it explicitly. Pair/list order immaterial in tests.

objective: Aggregate semicolon-delimited match results into a fixed-width standings table sorted by numeric points and team name.
review_note: Entire brief and all fixtures reviewed. Actual Python API accepts/returns lists of text rows, so filesystem IO is not required despite generic file wording. Match result refers to first named team; both records updated; empty input still yields header.

objective: Assemble cumulative song verses with animal-specific additions, a special spider clause and a terminal horse verse.
review_note: Full lyrics, stub and all tests read. Optional reinforcement after House/Twelve Days adds conditional embedded clauses and terminal case. Returns flattened lines with blank verse separators, not a list of whole verse strings.

objective: Generate chromatic and interval-defined scales with tonic-dependent sharp/flat spelling and cyclic note traversal.
review_note: Complete theory tables, both tasks, stub and all tests read. Actual strings use ASCII # and b rather than display glyphs. Interval result has N+1 notes and repeats octave tonic; case of tonic selects key spelling before normalization. Domain rules included locally.

objective: Find the greatest product of digits in adjacent windows and validate span and character constraints.
review_note: Full docs, stub and all cases read including 1,000-digit Euler fixture. Distinct progression from Series: numeric aggregation and zeros. Zero span behavior is not described/tested locally; do not invent a new learner requirement. Generators optional.

objective: Refactor an existing small Markdown-to-HTML parser while preserving heading, emphasis, paragraph and unordered-list behavior.
review_note: Read full actual baseline implementation and every supplied test, not just signatures. Primary explicitly assigns refactoring of implemented code, so do not exclude it as a solution. Restricted Markdown subset, not a production CommonMark parser. Baseline runtime needs separate verification.

objective: Resolve ordinal, last and teenth weekdays in a calendar month and raise a custom error for nonexistent fifth occurrences.
review_note: All docs, starter and supplied date/error test bodies read. Python append adds fifth beyond primary six descriptors. Return date object, not string. Custom MeetupDayException must carry That day does not exist. as exception.args[0].

objective: Generate Pascal triangle rows recursively with a zero-row base case and reject negative counts.
review_note: Full docs, starter and every test read. Python append mandates recursion; test intentionally exceeds recursion limit. Error-message assertions are wrongly inside assertRaises after throwing call, making those assertions unreachable, though exception type still checked. Classes not required.

objective: Search files for fixed strings with composable case, inversion, whole-line, filename and line-number flags.
concepts: file reading;with statement;flag parsing;formatting;mocked IO tests
review_note: Full brief, introduction, starter, in-test text fixtures and all test bodies read. -l takes precedence over -n; multiple-input files add filename even if only one matches. Tests mock open, so named txt fixtures are not missing files. Fixed-string match, not regex search.

objective: Implement a doubly linked deque with operations at both ends, length tracking and deletion of the first matching value.
concepts: doubly linked nodes;head and tail invariants;mutation;exceptions
review_note: All docs, starter and tests read. Expands Simple Linked List with reverse links, shift/unshift and interior deletion. Empty pop/shift raise IndexError List is empty; missing delete raises ValueError Value not found. Must remain usable after becoming empty.

objective: Implement complex arithmetic, conjugation, magnitude and exponential as a custom numeric type interoperable with real operands.
requires: classes;dunder methods;operator overloading;reflected operators;arithmetic;math module;complex numbers
review_note: Full formulas, append, starter and all tests reviewed. Built-in complex support prohibited. Tests require reflected real-number operations absent starter signatures. Approximate-equality tests compare custom objects, so numerical comparison behavior needs consideration. Inheritance optional despite registry label.

objective: Refactor a duplicated ledger formatter in small verified steps while preserving locale, currency, ordering and display behavior.
review_note: Read full 280-line implemented baseline and all test bodies. This is explicitly refactorable source, not an accidental reference assignment. Source consumes entries list; tests do not specify preservation. Currency amounts in integer cents; description truncates at 25 columns. Record change log required. Baseline suite still needs verification.

objective: Model guessed-letter state, masked words and terminal win/loss behavior with repeat-guess penalties.
review_note: Full instructions, Python override, starter and every test read. Python explicitly needs no FRP library. Counter starts9; tests allow nine failures and a final winning guess at0, loss only after tenth failure. Clarify this tested convention; duplicate correct guesses cost a failure. Terminal further guesses raise specified error.

objective: Flood-fill empty Go-board regions, classify ownership by bordering stones and aggregate each player's territory.
review_note: Full brief, append, stub docstrings and all tests read. Board-game Go, not Go language. Four-neighbor adjacency differs from Hex. Stones themselves return empty territory; mixed/no bordering colors mean unowned. Tests import WHITE/BLACK/NONE missing stub, learner must define exported constants.

objective: Evaluate a case-insensitive stack language with arithmetic, stack words and user-defined word redefinitions.
review_note: Read full specification, append, starter and all cases. Definitions capture meanings at definition time: redefining foo later must not alter bar previously using foo. Signed literals supported; numeric names illegal; distinct exact underflow/undefined/illegal/zero-division errors required. Not a requirement to learn Forth separately.

objective: Construct a binary search tree from ordered inputs with duplicates on the left and return its in-order traversal.
review_note: Read full explanation, actual starter and every test. Tests use numeric-looking strings, not integers. Both TreeNode initializer and tree implementation need work. No search method required by tested API despite generic first sentence. Source efficiency claim needs balanced-vs-skewed complexity qualification.

objective: Simulate two card decks, payment chains and pile collection while detecting repeated states and counting played cards and tricks.
review_note: Full rules, complete worked tables, introduction, starter and every case reviewed, including long finite runs and looping decks. Number-card identities ignored for state equivalence, but sequence structure retained. Optional record-hunting extension is open-ended, not required exhaustive search.

objective: Implement reduced signed rational arithmetic with absolute value, integer/real powers and reflected exponentiation.
review_note: Full mathematical specification, starter and all tests read. Denominator standard form positive, zero numerator normalized to 0/1. Prose mentions fractional powers but suite tests only integer Rational powers and real-base reflected powers; requirement still retained. Denominator-zero note leaves behavior unspecified; no invented infinity support.

objective: Track ten bowling frames, delayed strike/spare bonuses and tenth-frame fill balls while rejecting invalid play and incomplete scoring.
review_note: All scoring rules, append, starter and every case read. Supplied tests accept any Exception subtype with nonempty message, not exact messages suggested in append. Bonus balls do not create further frames; rack resets depend on prior strike. Perfect score300 verified by fixture.

objective: Maximize value within weight capacity with each input item usable at most once.
review_note: Complete instructions, example, introduction and all tests read. API returns maximal total value, not selected items despite generic narrative. Duplicate item records represent separate available items. Both weight-greedy and value-greedy strategies explicitly fail supplied cases.

objective: Find shortest family separation after connecting parents to children and siblings directly, validating missing or disconnected people.
review_note: Full docs, starter and all fixtures read. Siblings have distance1, not2 through parent; no automatic direct edge between unrelated co-parents. Dictionary values include people who are not keys. Three precise errors distinguish missing A, missing B and no connection.

objective: Parse a Python tuple-based graph DSL into supplied Node/Edge objects and graph attributes with precise structural validation.
review_note: Full brief, Python append, provided Node/Edge code and every test read. Internal DSL, not a textual DOT parser or Graphviz installation exercise. Empty graph supported despite append saying one or more tuples. Exact test messages differ from append examples; follow test spelling.

objective: Implement set membership, equality, subset/disjoint tests, mutation, intersection, difference and union through a custom class.
review_note: Full brief, starter and every test read. Order-independent equality, duplicate removal and empty-set identities required. Internal representation unconstrained, built-in set not explicitly forbidden. Starter mutable default should not be mutated or shared across instances; inherited-class implementation not required.

objective: Solve the fifteen linked house constraints algorithmically to identify the water drinker and zebra owner.
review_note: Full puzzle, introduction, stub and two tests read. Tests check only constant final answers, not a search implementation; hardcoding would defeat task's actual objective. Avoid enumerating full Cartesian product of permutations without incremental pruning.

objective: Encode and decode affine substitution using coprime keys and modular inverses, preserving digits and grouping ciphertext.
review_note: Complete formulas, worked inverse, append, starter and all tests read. Adds inverse mathematics to Atbash/Rotational practice; not a duplicate. Noncoprime key rejected by encode and decode with exact message. Classes unnecessary despite metadata.

objective: Locate word endpoints along any of eight straight grid directions without wrapping or changing direction.
review_note: Full brief, starter and every case read. Python search(word) returns tuple of Point objects or None, not a mapping for a list of words. Rectangular one/two-row fixtures show board need not be square. Point initializer also needs completion; no wrapping across edges.

objective: Solve letter-to-distinct-digit addition puzzles while prohibiting multi-digit leading zeros and reporting no solution.
review_note: Read full specification, starter and every test including skipped extra-credit 199-addend fixture. Return mapping or None; local syntax uses ==. Single-letter zero allowed by prose. Large ten-letter puzzle motivates arithmetic pruning. Skipped extension reviewed but not executed by reference suite; keep optional.

objective: Model account open/close state and validated sequential deposits and withdrawals with reset on reopening.
review_note: All docs, starter and tests reviewed. Python append explicitly removes concurrency requirement; this is not a concurrency unit. Append's blanket GIL claim is misleading; do not teach it as fact. Full-balance withdrawal permitted despite less-than error wording. Zero-amount behavior not tested; prose error suggests positive amounts.

objective: Build reactive input and computed cells that propagate changes to a stable state before emitting changed-value callbacks.
review_note: Full brief, starter and every test read. Unrelated to React frontend framework. Diamond dependencies must not emit transient values; no callback when final value unchanged. Removing already-removed callback harmless. Inheritance/descriptors are possible approaches rather than mandatory APIs.

objective: Navigate and update a focused binary tree while preserving the context needed to reconstruct the full tree.
review_note: Full generic brief, stub and every test read. Brief describes rose-tree sibling APIs not used by Python tests; tested binary API is left/right/up/set_left/set_right/set_value/to_tree. Setter arguments missing in stub intentionally need completion. Preserve functional model even though tests do not verify original zipper immutability.

objective: Find a legal minimum-action bucket-measuring plan with a specified initial fill and forbidden opposite full/empty state.
review_note: Full rules, examples, append and every test read. Count initial fill; return moves, goal-bucket name and other volume. Unreachable goal or goal above both capacities raises ValueError with nonempty message, not exact append placeholder. No class required despite metadata.

objective: Order and orient every supplied domino into a closed matching chain or return None if impossible.
review_note: Read full instructions, introduction, stub and entire custom test validator. Preserve duplicate tiles; disconnected even-degree components still invalid. Empty input returns empty chain. Despite function name can_chain, return actual chain, not boolean. Every edge used once, ends must match.

objective: Reconstruct a unique-item binary tree from preorder and inorder traversals and validate traversal compatibility.
review_note: Full primary, append, starter and all tests read. Empty tree represented by {}, nodes use v/l/r dictionary keys. Length, elements and uniqueness have separate exact error messages. No real networking or satellite integration involved; classes optional.

objective: Choose discounted groups of distinct book titles to minimize the total integer-cent price of any basket.
review_note: Complete discount specification, worked competing groupings, starter and every test read. Largest possible group greedily is not always optimal; two groups of four beat five plus three. API returns cents, not dollar floats. Advanced optimization, not merely sets practice.

objective: Parse SGF text into a property-bearing game tree with variations, repeated property values and exact escaping rules.
review_note: Read entire local format explanation, append, supplied SgfTree implementation and every test. Escape handling differs from Python literals: escaped newline disappears, escaped n remains n, tabs become spaces. Semicolons/parentheses inside property values are data. Local subset excludes optional external whitespace and CRLF.

objective: Meter actual bytes and calls through an inherited file wrapper and a delegated socket wrapper while preserving IO protocols.
review_note: Full brief, starter, all tests and helper implementation read. Count actual partial transfer lengths, not requested bytes. __exit__ must propagate suppression behavior; statistics read-only. Tests explicitly require subclassing file and delegating socket rather than interchangeable designs. No live network needed for suite.

objective: Model JSON IOU endpoints for user creation, sorted lookup and netting reciprocal debts between users.
review_note: Full schema, endpoint table, starter and every test read. Actual API is in-process get/post methods taking JSON strings, not a running HTTP service or SQL database. Opposing IOUs cancel, remove zero debt edges, update mirrored records. Place before real framework/backend projects.

objective: Reroot an existing tree at a selected label and return paths between arbitrary nodes while retaining all side branches.
review_note: Full brief, append, provided serialization/comparison code and every test read. Source uses __dict__ as callable method, unusual but supplied contract. Child order ignored by provided equality. Missing source node and missing destination produce different messages. No external serialization task added.

objective: Apply a supplied operation to each collection element without using built-in map equivalents.
review_note: Full brief, restriction, stub and all tests read. Deprecated upstream but functional and worthwhile as optional preparation for List Ops. Includes nested accumulation and divmod tuple outputs; collection result is a list. Do not discard solely because deprecated.

objective: Parse binary text into an integer from first principles and reject nonbinary literals with a meaningful exact message.
review_note: Complete docs, starter and every test read. Deprecated but functional; retain optional preparatory variant before All Your Base. No built-in conversion permitted. No empty-string contract specified by tests; do not add requirements.

objective: Compare exception, None and success-tuple failure signaling and guarantee filelike cleanup on success and failure.
requires: functions;None;tuples;numeric conversion;raising and handling exceptions;context managers;object methods
review_note: All docs, starter, full tests and FileLike helper read. Deprecated upstream but reference suite passes. Call do_something and propagate its failure after cleanup. Helper sets was_open only in close(), so name means opened-and-closed; do not infer chronology from attribute name alone.

objective: Convert case-insensitive hexadecimal text to decimal from first principles and reject invalid literals.
review_note: Full brief, stub and every test reviewed. Deprecated but functional optional practice extending Binary with alphabetic digits and case normalization. No built-in conversion allowed. Tests require ValueError with any nonempty message, not a particular wording.

objective: Convert octal digit strings to decimal while validating allowed digits.
review_note: Full task, starter and tests reviewed. Quarantine: instructions explicitly require treating invalid input as octal0, while tests require ValueError for 8, carrot and6789. Deprecated and redundant with stronger All Your Base; reference passes tests but cannot satisfy contradictory invalid-input prose.

objective: Count nucleotide differences across paired positions.
review_note: Full brief, starter and all tests reviewed. Explicitly replaced by Hamming. Prose promises equal-length inputs and defines Hamming distance only there, but tests require ignoring unequal trailing lengths. Exclude contradictory legacy duplicate; retain verified Hamming with explicit equal-length validation.

objective: Partition a collection into predicate-matching and nonmatching lists without built-in filter equivalents.
review_note: Full brief, restriction, stub and all tests read. Deprecated but functional optional practice before List Ops. Adds discard and keep/discard partition identity beyond List Ops filter; preserves original element order within each result.

objective: Generate countdown song lines with singular and zero-bottle exceptions and a store-reset final verse.
review_note: Read complete 100-verse source lyrics and full test output including all-verses fixture. Deprecated overlapping Bottle Song variant retained optional. Adds zero/reset verse and pronoun it rather than one; same API start/take but two lines per verse. No distinct core slot needed.

objective: Generate private/public keys and verify matching shared secrets through modular exponentiation.
review_note: Full exchange steps, random/secrets append, starter and all tests reviewed. Deprecated but functional optional mathematical protocol exercise. Five sampled keys must differ, a probabilistic check rather than proof. Use efficient modular exponentiation; educational small-parameter implementation not a production protocol.

objective: Convert base-three strings from first principles and return zero for invalid digits.
review_note: Full brief, starter and every test read. Deprecated but functional optional transfer practice with different invalid-input convention than Binary/Hexadecimal/All Your Base. Default sentinel zero makes invalid and valid-zero indistinguishable; discuss tradeoff after Error Handling.

objective: Annotate empty grid squares with adjacent mine counts and reject invalid grids.
review_note: Full docs, starter and every test read. Deprecated near-exact duplicate of Flower Field, with identical shape/character error and same algorithm/API. Flower Field adds an adjacent-double-flower test. Preserve this source as alternate practice link on Flower Field rather than duplicate a numbered assignment; not broken.

objective: Count individual and all DNA nucleotide frequencies, including zero-count entries and validation.
review_note: Full specification, starter and all tests read. Deprecated but functional optional practice. Tests validate queried nucleotide X but do not test invalid strand characters, although prose requires rejecting invalid strand. Include full requirement; tests alone insufficient.

objective: Count case-insensitive alphabetic frequencies across texts using parallel computation and merge partial counts.
review_note: Complete brief, starter and all tests read. Deprecated but functional instructor reference. Tests verify counts only, not actual parallel execution; parallelism remains prose requirement. Numbers, punctuation and whitespace ignored; include Unicode-aware isalpha behavior from fixture.

objective: Return an exactly padded five-line name banner and accept whitespace-trimmed command-line name words with a default.
review_note: Full brief/starter/requirements/constraints/output/steps/acceptance/stretch read; inline worked-answer section deliberately omitted. Six spaces per side, returns rather than prints, required str.center. Stretch includes interactive input, --char parsing, file input, optional colorama and module reuse: defer those until input/CLI/files/exceptions/packages prerequisites, not required base checks. Companion full implementation still to inspect as instructor resource.

objective: Report interpreter, platform, working directory, venv state and a sorted deduplicated installed-distribution inventory.
review_note: Full content-bearing page read separately after truncated batch. Runtime output intentionally variable; assert structure/facts, not sample versions. Must use importlib.metadata and sys.prefix/base_prefix rather than subprocess pip or VIRTUAL_ENV. Empty package list safe. Stretch JSON/output files/color/comparison deferred until those skills. Source absolute prefix claim assumes normal supported venv context; directory-name substring is not reliable test.

objective: Run a documented script that prints an exact greeting, personal name and the actual interpreter major/minor version.
review_note: Entire student-brief view read separately. Source explicitly scaffolds function/annotations for learners rather than expecting design, but unified path should introduce syntax first. Version dynamic; no hardcoded sample3.13. Stretch sys.platform and return-list refactor retained after respective skills. Claim that every venv path contains .venv is false for arbitrary environment names.

objective: Explore floor/true division in the REPL and implement asserted table/pizza ceiling counts and rounded cost per person.
review_note: Full brief/starter/constraints/expected transcript/steps/acceptance/stretch read. Requires -(-a//b), no math import for base work; preserve assertions. Large-integer ceil comparison and divmod are optional extensions after math module/tuples. Source's decimals explanation means binary floating point; rounding final share may not exactly allocate a total bill.

objective: Compare normal and interactive-after-script execution while generating initials and longest-name summaries with empty-input handling.
review_note: Complete content-bearing page read. Must use max(names,key=len) and join, earliest longest tie wins, both functions return empty string for empty list. Interactive mutations do not persist across fresh runs. Stretch environment variable and importing under module namespace deferred until environment/modules skills. Execute interactive sessions manually, not unattended shell hangs.

objective: Verify the installed interpreter meets Python3.11+, run a REPL print and save version/output evidence in a committed notes file.
requires: terminal navigation;Python installation;print;creating text files;Git basics
review_note: Full brief, starter commands, requirements, expected session, steps, acceptance and stretch read. Requires Git before its final deliverable despite installation topic. which/where stretch must account for PowerShell where alias: use where.exe/Get-Command. Additional interpreter installation via pyenv is optional, not necessary to complete verification.

objective: Create a fresh project repository with a local ignored environment and one clean initial commit containing ignore rules and README.
review_note: Full student-brief view read. Initial single-commit requirement applies to learner's fresh exercise project, not this curriculum-authoring repository; user prefers many focused commits here. No remote until source homework5. Stretch global ignore configuration and deleting/rebuilding environment optional learner actions; not executed in source review. Source claim Git history never changes is simplified; do not teach as absolute.

objective: Write a personal introduction script with three typed constants, meaningful comments, a module docstring and three separate print calls.
review_note: Full student brief, starter, requirements, acceptance and stretch reviewed. Module docstring must be the first statement and survive import without printing; it is not a comment. Require three separate print calls. Comment-counting generator/file-reading stretch deferred until those skills; companion completed code is instructor material.

objective: Install requests in the project environment, generate requirements with pip freeze and verify reproducibility and import versions.
review_note: Full student brief reviewed. Requirements must be generated rather than handwritten; version values are observations, not prescribed sample pins. Rebuild verification is in acceptance, not merely optional stretch. Freeze does not list every environment tool by default. Do not commit the environment. No packages or extra learner environments were created during this review.

objective: Publish the existing homework repository to an empty public remote and verify tracked files, commit history and upstream configuration.
requires: project skeleton;Git commits;requirements snapshot;about-me script;GitHub account
review_note: Full student brief reviewed. Depends explicitly on homework2-4. No runnable companion by design. Public account/network activity belongs to learner activity, not source inspection. Source claim GitHub never runs or checks anything is inaccurate: repository hosting and optional Actions are distinct. Token-specific acceptance is narrower than other valid authentication methods. SSH/API extensions require separate later skills; never expose credentials.

objective: Collect a stripped name and three stripped tasks using reusable functions and print an enumerated daily plan, then commit and push it.
review_note: Full starter, requirements, steps, acceptance and stretch reviewed. TASK_COUNT is the sole task-count constant; strip before storage. Heading-on-own-line or consistent inline interpretation explicitly accepted. Prompts use stderr so stdout contains the plan. Source browser-only/no-setup claim conflicts with Git/environment deliverables and cannot replace them. Date/file-writing and nested-loop rejection extensions deferred until their prerequisites; starter lacks companion demo fallback described for downloadable answer.

objective: Swap two volunteers and rotate three using tuple returns and unpacking, then explain why sequential reassignment loses a value.
review_note: Full student brief, starter, steps, acceptance and stretch read. Both functions require one return expression, no temporary or list. Rotation sends third to first. Earliest incomplete run prints five lines before unpacking None fails. mypy optional. Inverse rotation with starred argument unpacking deferred until that skill. Overlaps learn.python beginner swap but adds three-way rotation and a specific failure investigation; retain as progressive practice.

objective: Return a centered title bar and aligned lab-minute report rows using dynamic widths, thousands grouping and fraction-to-percentage formatting.
review_note: Full student brief, starter, steps, acceptance and stretch read. Base widths14+7+8=29; percentage input is a fraction, not already multiplied by100. Format widths are minimum widths: source universal any-row-exactly29 assertion only holds when content fits, so constrain supplied fixtures or document overflow rather than silently truncate. Complete instructor reference read and executed: supplied expected block matches all8 lines exactly; oversized30-character name produces45-character row, confirming minimum-width limitation. Temporary constant changes in steps are experiments, restore originals for acceptance. Stretch signs/hours/grouping remain attached extensions.

objective: Implement three pure temperature conversions using shared constants and investigate float round trips with an absolute tolerance.
review_note: Full student brief and starter reviewed. No input, output, imports, floor division or early rounding inside conversion functions. Preserve constants and table driver. Six reference points include -40 and body temperature. Kelvin domain validation is not requested; do not claim function prevents physically impossible inputs. Source wording about a one with nine zeros in front is imprecise; 1e-9 is 0.000000001. Complete instructor reference read and executed: supplied expected block matches all11 lines exactly. Exact round-trip claim is specific to prescribed expression/constants and fixture, not every equivalent formula.

objective: Parse integers into an optional result, retry invalid interactive input and display seven arithmetic operations with guarded zero division.
review_note: Full student brief, starter, requirements, acceptance and stretch reviewed. Learner writes parse_int and division display only, preserves supplied retry/argument driver. Zero must be accepted using is-not-None. Negative exponent-base output is textual, not a reparsable Python expression. Universal any-input-never-crashes claim is too broad: 0 with a negative exponent raises ZeroDivisionError in unchanged exponent line, huge integer powers/output limits and KeyboardInterrupt remain possible. Restrict documented acceptance to supplied cases and record uncovered domain. Default no-input demo and explicit --ask paths differ intentionally; retry-limit/higher-order converter extensions unlock later. Reference execution matches all7 supplied default lines and reproduces ZeroDivisionError for describe(0,-1); complete reference file read.

objective: Read principal, percentage rate and integer years, calculate simple interest and print an aligned five-line numeric report.
review_note: Full student brief reviewed. Rate is a percentage input divided by100 for arithmetic; rate suffix consumes one field column. Interactive starter does not contain downloadable answer's no-input demo fallback. Literal sample alignment may differ from fixed-width starter; verify before exact-output acceptance. Year-table loop and dynamic-label generator stretches deferred. Pedagogical calculation only, not financial advice or external activity.

objective: Compute the supplied BMI formula and store four mutually exclusive category flags using comparisons without branching.
review_note: Full student brief reviewed. Compare unrounded value and only round display; boundaries18.5,25,30 enter upper band. Core no-if constraint applies to band logic, not main guard. Limit exercise to sensible positive finite inputs; starter neither validates height nor catches conversion errors. Population-statistic caveat already in source; this is formula practice. Imperial703 is an approximation, not exactly the conversion constant as stretch claims. Boolean indexing and tuple category extensions require collections first.

objective: Read an unchanged text line and report code-point length, length without literal spaces, whitespace-split word count and uppercase text without explicit loops.
review_note: Full student brief reviewed. Do not strip input. Non-space excludes only ASCII spaces, whereas split handles general whitespace. len counts Python string code points, not visual graphemes. Source multi-space example says split-space yields seven but actually six fields for the supplied21-character input; correct annotation needed. Vowel generator stretch violates literal no-for constraint and is only valid as a later relaxed extension. Average empty-input handling and slicing extensions require their prerequisites.

objective: Map a numeric score to a letter by adding four parenthesized threshold comparisons and indexing a low-to-high grade string.
review_note: Full student brief reviewed. Exact thresholds60,70,80,90 and mappingFDCBA; no branching in grading logic. Nominal domain0..100; clamping extension discusses rather than hides invalid input. Plus/minus labels need a list/tuple of multicharacter strings, not simple character indexing. Grade-point extension explicitly uses custom4,3,2,1,0 mapping; do not imply a universal institutional grading scale. Table ranges with .99 shorthand mean continuous threshold intervals, not omitted fractional values.

objective: Calculate annual compound growth and total interest, format a five-line report and compare it with simple interest over longer horizons.
review_note: Full student brief reviewed. Preserve parentheses and compute interest by subtraction; delay display rounding. Useful progressive overlap with simple-interest task, not duplicate. Source says gains shrink with more frequent compounding; total increases for positive rate, with diminishing increments. Decimal extension legitimately differs at a half-cent and requires Decimal/context instruction first. Continuous limit extension requires math and numerical-limit understanding. Financial scenarios are exercise fixtures, not advice; rates/domain assumptions need stated constraints.

objective: Convert a trip distance with an exact named factor, derive speeds from distance and elapsed time and reject nonpositive durations before dividing.
review_note: Full student brief reviewed. KM_PER_MILE1.609344 exact; mph must derive from miles, not duplicate conversion. Heading plus five report lines; error-only requirement excludes interactive prompts already emitted. Positive-time check with <=0 does not reject NaN; sensible finite numeric-input domain implicit, no parse-error handling requested. Distance guard/pace extension later; pace also needs positive distance and seconds/minutes boundary rounding. Optional function extraction feeds mini-project rather than becoming an invented new assignment.

objective: Encode and decode English letters with modular shifts while preserving case and other characters, validating signed shift input and repeating sessions.
